how_to_find: Open your fork on GitHub. Look at the date of the newest commit that came from the original repository (for example commit 20ea0cc dated 2026-08-05). The app has no version number in its code and no git tags were seen (VERIFY). Match that commit date to the entries below.

versions.title: Version at first wizard release
versions.summary: The setup wizard was released. The product code is at commit 20ea0cc dated 2026-08-05 (Hold the background still on the manage page). Later changes will appear above this entry.

changes.text: Setup wizard for Make a Playlist. It covers fork, Railway database and API, Netlify front end, brand and first test.
